Introducing TV Remote Control · Universal – the simplest and fastest way to control your TV directly from your iPhone.
Turn your phone into a smart, reliable TV remote you can use anytime, anywhere.

• Instant TV Control
Connect your iPhone to your TV over the same Wi-Fi network and start controlling it instantly. Change channels, adjust volume, navigate menus, and control playback in seconds.

• Smart & Intuitive Interface
A clean, user-friendly design makes controlling your TV effortless. Everything you need is right at your fingertips — simple, fast, and responsive.

• Wide TV Compatibility
Works with most popular Smart TV brands that support control via local network connection.
Various operating systems are supported. One app for multiple TVs in your home.

• No Extra Devices Needed
No physical remote, no cables, no additional hardware. Just your iPhone and your TV — that’s it.

• Always Ready When You Need It
Perfect when your remote is lost, batteries are dead, or you simply prefer controlling your TV from your phone.

Upgrade your daily TV experience with a tool built for speed, simplicity, and convenience.

Download TV Remote Control · Universal today and take full control of your TV — effortlessly.

*This application is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any television manufacturer.

Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:

- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase;
- Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually at the rate based on the subscription plan
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period;
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan;
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase;
